data.one_liner: Adds labeled markers to Google Maps in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a LabelMarker widget and an addLabelMarker() helper to place map markers with custom text labels. Allows background color and font style customization for the label.
use_when: You need simple text labels on Google Maps markers without building custom marker images
You want a quick way to add labeled markers using the existing google_maps_flutter plugin
avoid_when: You require complex marker clustering or advanced map interactions
You need platform‑independent map solutions beyond Google Maps
strengths: Minimal code to add labeled markers
weaknesses: No built‑in clustering or performance optimizations for many markers
Requires manual setState after adding a marker

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides full control over markers and supports custom bitmap icons without extra packages

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers an open‑source map solution with flexible marker customization and works with various map providers
